period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of optometrist.

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of optometry

title_protection.quote: representing oneself as or using the title of "optometrist," "optometric physician," "doctor of optometry," or "O.D.," unless currently licensed under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of optometry, except as specifically provided in Section 58-1-307 or 58-16a-305.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining any optometry diploma, license, certificate, or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining, any optometry diploma, license, certificate, or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or providing contact lenses or ophthalmic lenses inconsistently with statute or intentionally altering a prescription
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling or providing contact lenses or ophthalmic lenses in a manner inconsistent with Section 58-16a-801 or intentionally altering a prescription unless the person selling or providing the lenses is a licensed optometrist or ophthalmologist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as or using the title of optometrist, optometric physician, doctor of optometry, or O.D. without a current license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: representing oneself as or using the title of "optometrist," "optometric physician," "doctor of optometry," or "O.D.," unless currently licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or employing an optometric assistant in a manner not in accordance with professional standards or applicable law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using or employing the services of an optometric assistant to assist a licensee in any manner not in accordance with: (a) the generally recognized practices and standards of ethics of the profession; or (b) applicable state law or division rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when the condition does not respond to treatment or is outside the licensee's scope
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when: (a) the patient's condition does not respond to treatment; or (b) the treatment is not within the scope of competence or licensure of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing confidential patient information to a third party without legal or professional grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing confidential information regarding a patient to any third party who does not have a legal and professional ground for obtaining the information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly prescribing, selling, giving away, or administering any prescription drug without legitimate medical purpose, proper diagnosis, or in violation of statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly prescribing, selling, giving away, or administering any prescription drug unless: (a) for a legitimate medical purpose; (b) upon a proper diagnosis indicating the use of the drug in the amount prescribed or provided; and (c) in compliance with Section 58-17b-309

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually and personally rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: giving or receiving directly or indirectly any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually and personally rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transfer pertinent patient medical record information to another optometrist or physician when requested by the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to transfer pertinent and necessary information from a patient's medical records to another optometrist or physician when so requested by the patient or his representative, as designated in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide a contact lens prescription to a person who sells contact lenses as required by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide a contact lens prescription to a person who sells contact lenses in accordance with Section 58-16a-306

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in or altering a medical record with intent to conceal wrongful conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (a) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter

definition_quote.value: "Optometry" and "practice of optometry" mean any one or any combination of the following practices: (a) examination of the human eye and its adnexa to detect and diagnose defects or abnormal conditions; (b) determination or modification of the accommodative or refractive state of the human eye or its range or power of vision by administration and prescription of pharmaceutical agents or the use of diagnostic instruments; (c) prescription, ordering, administration, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, ophthalmic devices, pharmaceutical agents, laboratory tests, or ocular exercises to diagnose and treat diseases, defects, or other abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; (d) display of any advertisement, circular, sign, or device offering to examine the eyes, fit glasses or contact lenses, or adjust frames; (e) removal of a foreign body from the eye or its adnexa, that is not deeper than the anterior 1/2 of the cornea; and (f) consultation regarding the eye and its adnexa with other appropriate health care providers, including referral to other appropriate health care providers.
definition_quote.quote: "Optometry" and "practice of optometry" mean any one or any combination of the following practices

value: examination and diagnosis of the human eye and its adnexa
determination or modification of refractive/accommodative state
prescription and administration of pharmaceutical agents including oral agents
prescription and adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, ophthalmic devices
removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye or adnexa (not deeper than anterior 1/2 of cornea)
consultation and referral to other health care providers
methods_authorized.quote: prescription, ordering, administration, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, ophthalmic devices, pharmaceutical agents, laboratory tests, or ocular exercises to diagnose and treat diseases, defects, or other abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa

drug_authority.value: May prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents; oral antibiotics limited to eyelid-related ocular conditions or as specified by rule; Schedule III controlled substances and hydrocodone combination drugs limited to 72-hour supply for eye/adnexa pain, no refills; Schedule II controlled substances prohibited except hydrocodone combination drugs if so scheduled.
drug_authority.quote: prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents, subject to the following conditions

surgery_prohibited.quote: An optometrist may not: (a) perform surgery, including laser surgery

surgery_definition.value: Surgery in which human tissue is cut, burned, or vaporized by means of laser or ionizing radiation (for laser surgery); general surgery prohibition also applies
surgery_definition.quote: "Laser surgery" means surgery in which human tissue is cut, burned, or vaporized by means of laser or ionizing radiation.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: removal of a foreign body from the eye or its adnexa, that is not deeper than the anterior 1/2 of the cornea

value: Schedule II controlled substances prohibited (except hydrocodone combination drugs if so scheduled and prescribed per Subsection (1)(b))
Schedule III controlled substances permitted only for pain of the eye or adnexa, oral or topical use, 72-hour supply maximum, no refills
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: An optometrist may not: ... (b) prescribe or administer a Schedule II controlled substance, as defined in Section 58-37-4, except for a hydrocodone combination drug, if so scheduled and prescribed or administered in accordance with Subsection (1)(b).

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: the amount of the substance administered or prescribed does not exceed a 72-hour quantity

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: prescribe or administer pharmaceutical agents for the eye and its adnexa, including oral agents

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: have passed examinations approved by the division in consultation with the board that include: (a) a standardized national optometry examination; (b) a standardized clinical examination; and (c) a standardized national therapeutics examination

referral_to_physician_required.quote: failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed practitioner when: (a) the patient's condition does not respond to treatment; or (b) the treatment is not within the scope of competence or licensure of the licensee

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: "Optometric assistant" means an unlicensed individual: (a) working under the direct and immediate supervision of a licensed optometrist; and (b) engaged in specific tasks assigned by the licensed optometrist in accordance with the standards and ethics of the profession.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: the expiration date of the prescription, which shall be two years from the commencement date, unless documented medical reasons require otherwise.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: he maintains a copy of the patient's contact lens prescription for not less than seven years

criminal_background_check_required.quote: consent to, and complete, a criminal background check, described in Section 58-1-301.5
